messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell your doctor if you have ever had blood clot or blood clotting disorder"
set: ["tell your doctor if you have ever had blood clot or blood clotting disorder", "tell your doctor if you have ever had anemia", "tell your doctor if you have ever had diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have ever had thyroiditis", "blood clotting disorder", "tell your doctor if you have ever had heart problems", "tell your doctor if you have ever had thyroid nodule", "tell your doctor if you have ever had weak bones", "tell your doctor if you have ever had liver or kidney disease", "tell doctor about history of bleeding or blood clotting disorder", "blood clotting", "tell doctor if have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease", "tell your doctor if you have ever had problems with your pituitary or adrenal gland", "tell doctor if have or had stroke or high blood pressure", "tell your doctor if you have ever had allergy to any food or drugs", "tell doctor if ever had high ketone levels in blood or urine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
